'''Zeta Zero Nine''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[the Wastes]] of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Located in the forbidden [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="DH" /> of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC" /> known as the Wastes, this world was known only by its preliminary scout identification number, Zeta Zero Nine. Its surface consisted of unstable, pitching ice [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] surrounding treacherous, rocky islands. The planet's oddly-shaped orbital plane exerted tremendous tidal forces on the seas, causing them to pitch like stormy oceans, and its magnetic field interfered with long-range [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and communications. Because of this, no detailed scans of the surface were made, and information on any natural life forms existing on the world remained unknown to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] scouting services.<ref name="DH" />

==History==
In the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet was the site of the secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Underwater Zeta Zero Nine base|research facility]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jesco Comark]]'s [[Death-Hunter Cyborg|Death Hunter]] [[Operation Death-Hunter|project]], transforming captured [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from nearby [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]] into loyal [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] assassins. The facility was eventually destroyed by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] agents and nearly all of the captured humans were freed.<ref name="DH" />
